claims.summary: In the r37 balanced triangle, right-plane mismatch injects physical third volume: Z_K >= Delta^2 sigma_*^2 delta_K. At the fixed live threshold Z0=Delta^2 sigma_*^2/64, either D3 pays continuously with density <658 under its row-marginal gate, a physical K-row third-volume anchor appears, or the two K-side top planes are within principal-angle defect <1/64 and one common 2D K-plane retains both rank-two legs with determinants at least Delta and (63/64)Delta.

For H=[[0,C,N],[C^T,0,P],[N^T,P^T,0]] with N,P invertible and R=N^{-1}CP^{-T}, det H=det(N)^2 det(P)^2 det(R+R^T) and rank H=4+rank(R+R^T). Simultaneous orthogonal normalization gives R=[[s,a],[-a,t]].

Prove a product-safe density/small-ball bound for the exact common 2+2+2 normalized cycle, retaining arbitrary same-bank phases and original-product provenance; the projected-crossing theorem has zero projected-crossing currency at exact common alignment.
Unrestricted three-large-eigenvalue quadratic-form bounded-density conjecture remains neither proved nor disproved; global continuity remains open.
